description: Shockwave therapy, occupational therapy and ambulatory ECG rules from Daman's public guidelines. Applied to SEAL's fictional insurers.

rules.title: Shockwave therapy outside the covered indications
rules.insurerNeeds: One of: lateral epicondylitis, calcaneal spur/plantar fasciitis, calcifying tendinitis of the shoulder, or trochanteric bursitis.

source.title: Extracorporeal Shockwave Therapy in Musculoskeletal Indications
source.quote: Daman covers Extracorporeal shockwave therapy (ESWT) for the below listed musculoskeletal indications, when pain persists for 6 months, and conservative treatments fail to achieve improvement: Lateral epicondylitis. Calcaneal spur/Plantar fasciitis. Calcifying tendinitis of the shoulder. Non-refractory Trochanteric bursitis (hip).

rules.title: Shockwave therapy without 6 months of pain and failed conservative treatment
rules.insurerNeeds: Pain for at least 6 months and conservative treatment completed without improvement, documented.
fixTemplates: Pain for ____ months. Conservative treatment tried: ____ for ____ weeks, without improvement.

source.title: Extracorporeal Shockwave Therapy in Musculoskeletal Indications
source.quote: Daman does not cover extracorporeal shock wave therapy (ESWT) if documentation failed to prove that patient, meeting the diagnosis criteria, has been for six months on conservative therapy which were unsuccessfully completed.

rules.title: More than 6 shockwave sessions per policy
rules.insurerNeeds: Approval is limited to 6 sessions per policy per member; continued sessions need a documented pain-score improvement of at least 1 point (15%).
fixTemplates: Pain score improved from ____ to ____ (NPRS) since session 1.

source.title: Extracorporeal Shockwave Therapy in Musculoskeletal Indications
source.quote: For continued coverage, provider must document the at least a 1 point (15%) reduction from baseline decrease on the Numeric Pain Rating Scale. Approval is limited to 6 sessions per policy per member

rules.notes: 'Per policy' is modelled as a rolling 365 days. The guideline's code list has MNEC-003, MNEC-004 and CODE-010 only; MNEC-003 chosen.

rules.title: Shockwave therapy by an ineligible specialty
rules.insurerNeeds: Ordered by orthopaedics, rheumatology, physical medicine and rehabilitation, or sports medicine.

source.title: Extracorporeal Shockwave Therapy in Musculoskeletal Indications
source.quote: Eligible clinician speciality: Orthopaedic, Rheumatologist, Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation, Sports medicine

source.title: Occupational Therapy Adjudication Guideline
source.quote: Group therapy will not be covered as it consists of simultaneous treatment of two or more patients who may or may not be doing the same activities.

rules.title: Routine occupational therapy re-evaluation
rules.insurerNeeds: New clinical findings, a significant change in condition, or failure to respond to the plan of care.
fixTemplates: Re-evaluation because ____ (new finding / unexpected change / no response to plan).

source.title: Occupational Therapy Adjudication Guideline
source.quote: A re-evaluation is not a routine, recurring service. … Indications for a re-evaluation include new clinical findings, a significant change in the patient's condition or failure to respond to the therapeutic interventions outlined in the plan of care.

rules.title: Routine ECG billed with ambulatory ECG in the same encounter
rules.insurerNeeds: A standard ECG cannot be billed with an ambulatory ECG service in the same encounter.

source.title: Ambulatory ECG Monitoring Adjudication Guideline
source.quote: Standard/ Routine ECG (CPT 93000, 93005,93010,93012,93014-93018) cannot be billed with any of the Ambulatory ECG services in the same encounter.

rules.notes: Guideline's code list (NCOV-003, CODE-010, MNEC-003/004/005) has no bundling code; MNEC-003 chosen.

rules.title: Ambulatory ECG by an ineligible specialty
rules.insurerNeeds: Ordered by an eligible specialty (surgery, anaesthesia, family medicine, critical care, internal medicine, paediatrics, cardiology, emergency medicine).

source.title: Ambulatory ECG Monitoring Adjudication Guideline
source.quote: Eligible Clinicians: Surgery, Anaesthesia, Family Medicine, Critical Care Medicine, Internal Medicine, Paediatrics, Cardiology, Anaesthesiology and Critical Care Medicine, Emergency Medicine
